summary: CPI day — March CPI prints pre-market. VIX broke below 20 (19.49) for first time since Iran war began. Semis (SMH) new 52-week high. SPY 6,824 (+0.62%). Oil rebounding toward $100 on ceasefire fragility (Israel struck Lebanon). Jobless claims softening (219K). Goldman warns of hedge fund short-squeeze risk. Tech and semis lead; defensives rotating out.

risks.label: CPI Release April 10
risks.detail: March CPI prints today. Oil shock could feed headline inflation. Hot print reprices Fed cuts and crushes tech/growth. Core consensus ~+0.30% m/m.

risks.label: Ceasefire Still Fragile
risks.detail: Israel struck Lebanon despite ceasefire. Iran threatening Hormuz closure. Any incident reverses the rally. Oil rebounding toward $100.

risks.label: Oil Rebound Risk
risks.detail: USO +1.91% to $126.96. Ceasefire fragility pushing oil back up. If WTI reaches $100, inflation/rate narrative reverses.

risks.label: Jobless Claims Softening
risks.detail: 219K (+16K) — labor market cracks appearing. Could signal growth slowdown ahead of earnings season.

risks.label: China Tariff War Active
risks.detail: 125% tariffs on US goods. Tech hardware and consumer electronics supply chains disrupted. TSM/AMD China revenue at risk.

risks.label: Taiwan Strait Risk
risks.detail: PLA exercises ongoing. TSM concentration in Taiwan = systemic chip supply risk. Low probability, extreme impact.

events.label: CPI March Data BMO
